Project.title: Project
Project.description: A long-form fantasy web novel project owned by an author.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the project owner.

title.description: Title of the fantasy web novel.

genre.description: Sub-genre of the fantasy web novel.

Character.title: Character
Character.description: A character profile belonging to a novel project.

linkedWorldbuildingIds.description: List of linked worldbuilding setting IDs (max 50).

WorldbuildingItem.title: WorldbuildingItem
WorldbuildingItem.description: A worldbuilding lore or rule setting belonging to a novel project.

Episode.title: Episode
Episode.description: A single episode manuscript belonging to a novel project.

Revision.title: Revision
Revision.description: An immutable manuscript snapshot for version recovery.

Scene.title: Scene
Scene.description: A narrative scene inside an episode linking events, characters, and foreshadowings.

Foreshadowing.title: Foreshadowing
Foreshadowing.description: A narrative clue or foreshadowing item tracked across episodes, scenes, events, and characters.

CharacterRelationship.title: CharacterRelationship
CharacterRelationship.description: A relationship between two characters in a project.

TimelineEvent.title: TimelineEvent
TimelineEvent.description: A chronological story event connected to episodes, scenes, characters, and foreshadowings.

MemoryDocument.title: MemoryDocument
MemoryDocument.description: A long-term memory document indexed for RAG retrieval.

MemoryChunk.title: MemoryChunk
MemoryChunk.description: A text chunk belonging to a MemoryDocument for RAG retrieval.

StyleProfile.title: StyleProfile
StyleProfile.description: An author or project narrative style profile for AI writing consistency.

ChangeProposal.title: ChangeProposal
ChangeProposal.description: An AI-proposed modification to a canon or draft setting awaiting author approval.

WritingPromptProfile.title: WritingPromptProfile
WritingPromptProfile.description: A versioned AI writing prompt template belonging to a project (Core Writing Rules, Style Profile, Dialogue Rules, Scene Instructions, Review Rules).

WritingPlan.title: WritingPlan
WritingPlan.description: An author-approved or draft AI scene plan for an episode.

ChangeProposalApprovalAudit.title: ChangeProposalApprovalAudit
ChangeProposalApprovalAudit.description: Immutable audit record created by the server Admin SDK when an author approves or rejects a ChangeProposal.

RagSyncTask.title: RagSyncTask
RagSyncTask.description: Server-side outbox task for post-commit RAG synchronization of approved CANON entities.

RagGenerationStagingReceipt.title: RagGenerationStagingReceipt
RagGenerationStagingReceipt.description: Durable server-side staging receipt for two-phase large-scale RAG generation indexing and pointer switching.
